email_application_received_body_1: thank you. We received your application for the listing {entryName} on {siteName}. Administrators review it within 7 days. We will send you the decision at this address.
email_application_received_body_2: Until then, the listing is not public. If you want to correct something, reply to this message.
email_approved_preheader_new: It is public. Set a password to edit it.
email_approved_preheader_existing: It is public. Log in to edit it.
email_approved_body_1: good news: the listing {entryName} passed review and is now public on {siteName}.
email_approved_body_new: We created an account for you. Set a password so you can edit the listing, post opportunities and connect with other listings. The link works for {expiry}.
email_approved_body_existing: You already have an account with this address, so log in with it to edit the listing, post opportunities and connect with other listings.
email_approved_body_2: After this first approval your changes go live at once.
email_rejected_preheader: The application for {entryName} was not approved. You can fix it and send it again.
email_rejected_body_1: we reviewed the application for the listing {entryName} on {siteName}. We cannot publish it for now.
email_rejected_reason_duplicate: The same or a very similar listing already exists on {siteName}. If it is yours, claim it instead of sending a new one: {claimHint}.
email_rejected_reason_out_of_scope: This listing is outside what {siteName} covers. The scope is described on the About page: {aboutLink}.
email_rejected_reason_incomplete: The application lacks information needed to publish it, for example a description, a contact or a place. Add it and send again.
email_rejected_reason_unverifiable: We could not verify the details in the application. Add a website or another public source that confirms the organization or your link to it, then send again.
email_rejected_body_2: You can edit the application and send it again. We keep it for 90 days, then it is deleted.
email_application_digest_preheader: {count} applications await a decision. The oldest is {oldestAge} days old.
email_application_digest_body: since the last summary, {count} applications arrived. In total {openTotal} are waiting for review. Applications older than {days} days are marked in the queue. Each line shows name, kind, country and age.
email_report_digest_body: since the last summary, visitors reported {count} listings. None was hidden automatically. They wait for your decision. Each line shows the listing and the reason the visitor gave.
email_edit_reverted_subject: An administrator reverted a change to {entryName}
email_edit_reverted_preheader: See what was reverted and why.
email_edit_reverted_body_1: an administrator of {siteName} reverted one of the changes made to your listing {entryName}.
email_edit_reverted_body_2: The rest of the listing was not changed. If you think this is a mistake, reply to this message or enter the change again.
email_suspended_subject: Your listing {entryName} was taken down for now
email_suspended_preheader: It is not public until the reason is resolved.
email_suspended_body_1: an administrator suspended the listing {entryName} on {siteName}. While it is suspended, the listing, its opportunities and its connections are not visible to visitors.
email_suspended_body_2: You can also see the reason in your account. If you can fix it, or think the suspension is wrong, reply to this message. When the suspension is lifted, everything returns as it was.
email_erasure_scheduled_preheader: You can cancel it within the next 14 days.
email_erasure_scheduled_body_entry: we received your request to delete your account and the listing {entryName} on {siteName}. The listing is already hidden. We will delete everything for good on {deleteDate}.
email_erasure_scheduled_body_account: we received your request to delete your account on {siteName}. We will delete it for good on {deleteDate}.
email_erasure_scheduled_what: We delete the listing, images, translations, contact details and connections. We remove personal data from the change log.
email_erasure_scheduled_cancel: Changed your mind? Until that date you can cancel the deletion in your account and everything returns.
email_erasure_scheduled_button: Open my data page to cancel
email_erasure_done_body_entry: we deleted your account and the listing {entryName} from {siteName}, with the images, translations, contact details and connections.
email_erasure_done_backups: We keep backups for at most 90 days, after which the data disappears from them too. [[GAP: lawyer to confirm the backup sentence]]
email_erasure_done_last: This is the last message we send you. If you want to return, you can always send a new application.
email_erasure_done_footer: You are getting this message because you asked to delete your account on {siteName}. We send it once and we do not keep your address. Questions: {contactEmail}. {controllerName}.
